key_highlights: ASX sheds $90bn in a week as rate-hike fears and oil price surge pressure miners and banks
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase
Oil prices explode as OPEC+ suppression fails; Australian fuel prices to rise 30c
RBA flags rental inflation as key concern; Fed rate hike near-certain globally
Mining sector sees wave of cap raises led by Canaccord; small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) outperform
Superannuation policy debate intensifies with One Nation proposals and structural criticism
Housing market bifurcates: high-end prices crash while affordable segment and first-home buyers surge
Australia softens gas supply rules, easing Asian energy security fears; Santos preservation noted

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners lead the $90bn selloff. However, small-cap explorers (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka, Kuniko, Gateway WA) show relative strength. Cap raises accelerating as Canaccord-led mining dash for cash intensifies.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from falling iron ore. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows. Small-cap miners offer speculative upside but dilution risk is elevated.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate-hike expectations pressure bank valuations. NIM compression risk if RBA holds while global rates rise. Woolworths price-freeze breach signals consumer pressure on deposit growth.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face headwinds from yield curve inversion risk and credit cycle concerns. Defensive dividend appeal remains but upside limited near-term.

sectors.trend: Positive. Oil price surge as OPEC+ suppression fails; Australian fuel prices to rise 30c. Santos preservation and softened gas supply rules support domestic energy names.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BRL.AX, SGO.AX benefit from higher oil. LNG exporters (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) gain from Asian gas demand. Fuel cost inflation pressures consumer sector.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths breaches price freeze on staples; businesses fear for future; renter solar access expanding. Consumer squeeze from fuel and rental inflation.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Defensive positioning warranted but pricing power under strain.

sectors.trend: Mixed. High-end property prices see steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. RBA rental inflation concern supports REIT occupancy but pressures valuations via higher discount rates.
sectors.implications: Property chiefs push for migration to support construction. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face yield compression risk. First-home buyer surge supports residential demand.

sectors.trend: Neutral to positive. CSL.AX insulated from commodity cycle. AI theme global (Goldman, SpaceX, Qualcomm) but limited direct ASX exposure. HIVE (HVN.AX) scales AI cloud via BUZZ HPC.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive diversification. ASX tech names remain thin; HVN.AX and Neurizon (NRZ.AX) are early-stage plays.

key_themes: Global rate-hike cycle (Fed near-certain) driving bond yield surge and equity de-rating
Iron ore structural decline vs. oil supply shock creating commodity divergence
AUD weakness amplifying import inflation and fuel cost pressures
Superannuation policy risk: One Nation proposals vs. structural integrity debate
Mining cap-raise wave signalling capital hunger and potential dilution
Housing market bifurcation: luxury correction vs. affordable resilience
Chinese inflation spike and geopolitical risk (Arctic shipping, India summit) weighing on demand outlook
RBA rental inflation focus may delay rate cuts, prolonging tight financial conditions

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-duration credit and floating-rate instruments. Hedge equity via ASX 200 puts.
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX) and energy (WDS.AX). Monitor Chinese stimulus.
Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies. Fuel cost pass-through risk to consumer staples.
Monitor One Nation proposals; ensure super fund diversification. Populist policy risk to APRA-regulated funds.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining sector dilution via cap raises
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid small-cap miners with repeated raises; favour well-funded majors or cash-flow-positive explorers.
Diversify away from China-exposed commodities. Monitor India summit outcomes and Arctic shipping routes.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy and gold on commodity divergence
opportunities.rationale: Oil surge and safe-haven flows favour WDS.AX, BRL.AX, GOLD.AX, NVG.AX as iron ore weakens

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and dividend payers
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX and SGH.AX insulated from commodity/rate cycle; provide portfolio stability amid volatility

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exposure on exploration upside
opportunities.rationale: PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka, Kuniko, Gateway WA showing momentum; battery tech (Critical Resources) in testing phase

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and China-exposed materials weight
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting and Chinese inflation spike signal demand deterioration; BHP/RIO/FMG under pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk via short-duration and floating-rate instruments
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed hike near-certain; RBA constrained by rental inflation; bond yields rising globally

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid overexposure to high-end property and REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at luxury end; rising discount rates pressure REIT valuations

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend losses as rate-hike fears persist, iron ore weakens, and AUD remains under pressure. Oil-driven energy outperformance offsets broad weakness. Expect elevated volatility into RBA commentary and US CPI data.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction at luxury end may stabilise; superannuation system remains structurally sound despite political noise. Energy transition and battery tech (Critical Resources) offer medium-term growth. Iron ore oversupply may persist 6-12 months.
key_catalysts: RBA statement on rental inflation and rate path
US Fed rate decision and dot plot
Iron ore contract price trajectory (BHP/RIO/FMG margins)
OPEC+ output policy and oil price sustainability
Chinese stimulus response to inflation spike
Australian gas supply rule implementation post-Santos
watch_list: Brent crude and Australian fuel prices (+30c)
RBA cash rate and rental inflation data
Housing price indices by segment (luxury vs. affordable)
Superannuation fund flows and policy announcements
